notablePrerequisites: Snow Hound does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Snow Hound by paying {1} and tapping it, returning itself and Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Cast Snow Hound by paying {2}{W}.
Repeat.
